suite: Actual app + touch controller + Game input integration (Node DOM fixture)
scope: Production input and simulation modules executed; event/capture DOM fixture and renderer/scene stubs. No browser layout, WebGL, Android device or content:// validation.

results.name: Actual application initializes touch controls without requesting Pointer Lock
Analog joystick dead zone yields zero, partial input retains partial movement speed
Oversized diagonal joystick input clamps to unit speed without diagonal boost
A second movement finger cannot steal the joystick or release its owner
Actual app handles move, look, and attack concurrently with independent pointers
Unknown pointer movements cannot rotate the camera; pitch remains clamped
Touch release clears only the released guard while movement stays active
Second finger on a held button cannot cancel the first finger guard
Pointer cancel and off-control release clear matching holds and visual state
Lost capture clears one pointer and remains safe under synchronous capture release
Pointer compatibility click is ignored; keyboard-activated action still works
Pause and resume clear all active pointers, guard, keyboard and queued interaction
Inventory opening clears holds and closing restores neutral touch controls
Actual held search progresses, release cancels, full hold opens starter loot
Touch release preserves a physically held keyboard move key
Search held by keyboard survives touch release, then cancels on final key release
Search held by touch survives keyboard release, then cancels on final touch release
resize clears all touch state through actual app listeners
orientationchange clears all touch state through actual app listeners
blur clears all touch state through actual app listeners
Hidden document clears touch state and pauses the actual game
Restart clears stale pointers and ignores their later move/up events
Manual off clears holds, manual on restores controls, invalid setting is ignored
Actual touch weapon attacks and timed reload consume the correct resources once
Touch healing, sprint, jump and dodge are routed through actual app actions
Desktop WASD and mouse attack/guard adapters remain functional
Desktop fallback arrow keys rotate the camera through actual merged input
First touch enables controls on a hybrid device without stealing keyboard keys
